<div class="top">About Us</div>
:<div class="subheader">''About Us''</div>
'''We are the ''Star Wars'' encyclopedia that anyone can edit''' &mdash; created by fans, for fans. Founded in 2005, our goal has been to build the '''most accurate, comprehensive, and well-presented''' resource about all things related to the galaxy far, far away.

'''We want readers like you to join our ranks!''' [[Special:Signup|Sign up for an account]] to remove ads, [[Wookieepedia:Discussions|chat]] with fellow fans, and [[Special:Community|join our editing community]]. Not sure where to start? Check out our dedicated [[Wookieepedia:Welcome, newcomers|'''welcome portal''']].
